arxiv-2102-11217.title: Gauge Fields as Constrained Composite Bosons
arxiv-2102-11217.creator: J.L. Chkareuli
arxiv-2102-11217.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by J.L. Chkareuli. We reconsider a scenario in which photons and other gauge fields appear as the composite vector bosons made of the fermion pairs that may happen with or without spontaneous violation of Lorentz invariance. The class of composite models for emergent gauge fields is proposed, where these fields are required to be restricted by the nonlinear covariant constraint of type A_{\mu}A^{\mu}=M^{2} .

arxiv-2206-12710.title: Protoformer: Embedding Prototypes for Transformers
arxiv-2206-12710.creator: Ashkan Farhangi, Ning Sui, Nan Hua, Haiyan Bai, Arthur Huang, Zhishan Guo
arxiv-2206-12710.description: Abstract Transformers have been widely applied in text classification. Unfortunately, real-world data contain anomalies and noisy labels that cause challenges for state-of-art Transformers. This paper proposes Protoformer, a novel self-learning framework for Transformers that can leverage problematic samples for text classification.

arxiv-2208-05002.title: Patronage and power in rural India: a study based on interaction networks Thanks: This project is funded by the European Union under the 7th Research Framework Programme (Theme SSH.2011.1), Grant acknowledgement number 290752. Kar acknowledges additional financial and infrastructural support from Ce
arxiv-2208-05002.creator: Anindya Bhattacharya Anirban Kar Sunil Kumar Alita Nandi
arxiv-2208-05002.description: Abstract This work has two intertwined components: first, as part of a research programme it introduces a new methodology for identifying ` ` power-centres’ in rural societies of developing countries in general and then applies that in the specific context of contemporary rural India for addressing some debates on the dynamics of power in rural India.

arxiv-2303-15603.title: Transverse flow under oscillating stimulation in helical square ducts with cochlea-like geometrical curvature and torsion
arxiv-2303-15603.creator: N.C. Harte, D. Obrist, M. Caversaccio, G.P.R. Lajoinie, W. Wimmer
arxiv-2303-15603.description: Abstract The cochlea is our fluid-filled organ of hearing with a unique spiral shape. The physiological role of this shape remains unclear. Previous research has paid only little attention to the occurrence of transverse flow in the cochlea, in particular in relation to the cochlea’s shape.

arxiv-2310-01563.title: Local algorithms and the failure of log-depth quantum advantage on sparse random CSPs
arxiv-2310-01563.creator: Antares Chen, Neng Huang, Kunal Marwaha
arxiv-2310-01563.description: Abstract We construct and analyze a message-passing algorithm for random constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs) at large clause density, generalizing work of El Alaoui, Montanari, and Sellke for Maximum Cut [ AMS21 ] through a connection between random CSPs and mean-field Ising spin glasses [ AMS20 , JMSS22 ] .

arxiv-2310-15034.title: Non-local skew and non-local sticky Brownian motions
arxiv-2310-15034.creator: Fausto Colantoni
arxiv-2310-15034.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a comprehensive study on the generalization of skew Brownian motion and two-sided sticky Brownian motion by considering non-local operators at the origin for the heat equations on the real line. To begin, we introduce Marchaud-type operators and Caputo-Dzherbashian-type operators, providing an in-depth exposition of their fundamental properties.

arxiv-2412-00770.title: Explorations in Self-Supervised Learning: Dataset Composition Testing for Object Classification
arxiv-2412-00770.creator: Raynor Kirkson E. Chavez* 1, Kyle Gabriel M. Reynoso* 1 Prospero C. Naval Jr. 1, Carlo R. Raquel 1
arxiv-2412-00770.description: Abstract This paper investigates the impact of sampling and pretraining using datasets with different image characteristics on the performance of self-supervised learning (SSL) models for object classification. To do this, we sample two apartment datasets from the Omnidata platform based on modality, luminosity, image size, and camera field of view and use them to pretrain a SimCLR model.

arxiv-2501-17289.title: A Contrastive Teacher-Student Framework for Novelty Detection under Style Shifts
arxiv-2501-17289.creator: Hossein Mirzaei, Mojtaba Nafez, Moein Madadi *, Arad Maleki *, Mahdi Hajialilue, Zeinab Sadat Taghavi, Sepehr Rezaee, Ali Ansari, Bahar Dibaei Nia, Kian Shamsaie, Mohammadreza Salehi, Mackenzie W. arxiv-2501-17289.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hossein Mirzaei, Mojtaba Nafez, Moein Madadi *, Arad Maleki *, Mahdi Hajialilue, Zeinab Sadat Taghavi, Sepehr Rezaee, Ali Ansari, Bahar Dibaei Nia, Kian Shamsaie, Mohammadreza Salehi, Mackenzie W. Mathis, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah, Mohammad Sabokrou, Mohammad Hossein Rohban. There have been several efforts to improve Novelty Detection (ND) performance. However, ND methods often suffer significant performance drops under minor distribution shifts caused by changes in the environment, known as style shifts.

arxiv-2502-08941.title: Analysis of Off-Policy n n -Step TD-Learning with Linear Function Approximation
arxiv-2502-08941.creator: Han-Dong Lim, Donghwan Lee
arxiv-2502-08941.description: Abstract This paper analyzes multi-step temporal difference (TD)-learning algorithms within the “deadly triad” scenario, characterized by linear function approximation, off-policy learning, and bootstrapping. In particular, we prove that n n -step TD-learning algorithms converge to a solution as the sampling horizon n n increases sufficiently. The paper is divided into two parts.

arxiv-2505-07349.title: Multi-Plane Vision Transformer for Hemorrhage Classification Using Axial and Sagittal MRI Data
arxiv-2505-07349.creator: Badhan Kumar Das, Gengyan Zhao, Boris Mailhe, Thomas J. Re, Dorin Comaniciu, Eli Gibson, Andreas Maier
arxiv-2505-07349.description: Abstract Identifying brain hemorrhages from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a critical task for healthcare professionals. The diverse nature of MRI acquisitions with varying contrasts and orientation introduce complexity in identifying hemorrhage using neural networks. For acquisitions with varying orientations, traditional methods often involve resampling images to a fixed plane, which can lead to information loss.

arxiv-2505-18420.title: LocalKMeans: Convergence of Lloyd’s Algorithm with Distributed Local Iterations
arxiv-2505-18420.creator: Harsh Vardhan, Heng Zhu, Avishek Ghosh, Arya Mazumdar
arxiv-2505-18420.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Harsh Vardhan, Heng Zhu, Avishek Ghosh, Arya Mazumdar. In this paper, we analyze the classical K K -means alternating-minimization algorithm, also known as Lloyd’s algorithm (Lloyd, 1956), for a mixture of Gaussians in a data-distributed setting that incorporates local iteration steps. Assuming unlabeled data distributed across multiple machines, we propose an algorithm, LocalKMeans, that performs Lloyd’s algorithm in parallel in the machines by running its iterations on local data, synchronizing only every L L of such local steps.

arxiv-2602-06917.title: Automatic Detection and Analysis of Singing Mistakes for Music Pedagogy Thanks: This work is supported by IMPRINT-2C grant from DST-SERB and by Prasar Bharati.
arxiv-2602-06917.creator: Sumit Kumar, Suraj Jaiswal, Parampreet Singh, Vipul Arora
arxiv-2602-06917.description: Abstract The advancement of machine learning in audio analysis has opened new possibilities for technology-enhanced music education. This paper introduces a framework for automatic singing mistake detection in the context of music pedagogy, supported by a newly curated dataset. The dataset comprises synchronized teacher–learner vocal recordings, with annotations marking different types of mistakes made by learners.

pmc-10577503.creator: Piercarlo Minoretti, Ángel García Martín, Manuel Gómez Serrano, Andrés Santiago Sáez, Miryam Liaño Riera, Enzo Emanuele
pmc-10577503.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: The possible associations between occupational factors and autophagy - a catabolic process that is evolutionarily conserved and serves as a vital cornerstone in maintaining cellular balance - remain largely unexplored.Objectives: We assessed serum levels of beclin-1, a principal effector of autophagy, and the mammalian/mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR), a protein recognized for its part in suppressing autophagy, within a group of healthy individuals hailing from three different professional fields, each characterized by its unique working conditions.Methods: A total of 60 men

pmc-10721692.title: 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 (HSD11B1) gene expression in muscle is linked to reduced skeletal muscle index in sarcopenic patients
pmc-10721692.creator: Sabine Schluessel, Wei Zhang, Hanna Nowotny, Martin Bidlingmaier, Stefan Hintze, Sonja Kunz, Sebastian Martini, Stefan Mehaffey, Peter Meinke, Carl Neuerburg, Ralf Schmidmaier, Benedikt Schoser, Nicole Reisch, Michael Drey
pmc-10721692.description: BackgroundGlucocorticoids play a significant role in metabolic processes and pathways that impact muscle size, mass, and function. The expression of 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 (HSD11B1) has been previously described as a major regulator of skeletal muscle function in glucocorticoid-induced muscle atrophy and aging humans.

pmc-10737026.title: NEIGHBORHOOD CONTEXT AND QUALITY OF LIFE OF OLDER ADULTS IN EASTERN NEPAL: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY

pmc-10737026.description: IntroductionIncreased life expectancy has resulted in population aging and subsequently entails addressing the needs of older adults. Shifting family structures from multigenerational to nuclear have had a significant effect on the older adults’ livelihood and their ways of interaction with community members.

pmc-11568450.title: The atypical soluble guanylyl cyclase subunit Gyc89Db does not control neuroepithelial proliferation in Drosophila larval brain
pmc-11568450.creator: Mariel Rosas, Rafael Cantera, Daniel Prieto
pmc-11568450.description: We investigated the role of oxygen-sensing atypical guanylyl cyclase subunit Gyc89Db in the developing brain. Despite its expression in the hypoxic neuroepithelium of the larval optic lobe of Drosophila , loss-of-function mutants and ectopic expression did not alter neuroepithelial cell number or proliferation.

pmc-11658045.title: Associations between serum uric acid and risk of depressive symptoms in East Asian populations
pmc-11658045.creator: Menghui Yao, Xinxin Han, Yue Yin, Shuolin Wang, Yingdong Han, He Zhao, Hong Di, Juan Wu, Yun Zhang, Xuejun Zeng
pmc-11658045.description: BackgroundDespite the fact that observational studies have reported associations between serum uric acid (SUA) and depressive symptoms risk in East Asian populations, there is a lack of evidence demonstrating a causal relationship between them. This study aimed to perform a comprehensive assessment of the relationship between SUA and depressive symptoms.

pmc-11733975.title: Atypical Location of Papillary Fibroelastoma in a Patient With Significant Oncologic History
pmc-11733975.creator: Adham Makarem, Patrick Udeh, Carly Liquori, Lucy Nam, Amy Sarma, Jonathan Salik, Edwin Choy, David D'Alessandro, Suzanne J Baron, Asishana Osho
pmc-11733975.description: This report discusses the case of a 57-year-old woman with a history of breast cancer and gastric cancer, germline CDH1 gene mutation, who presented to the hospital with syncope. Diagnostic workup revealed a mass in the right ventricular outflow tract. Transcatheter biopsy suggested papillary fibroelastoma, which was confirmed with surgical pathology.

pmc-12610381.title: Transcriptomic and Metabolic Profiles of Apple Peels of Different Colors
pmc-12610381.creator: Pingxing Ao, Yan Ma, Kang Luo, Yumei Ding, Hongjia Zhang, Yue Xu, Shaojie Yuan, Meng Zhang, Hui Guo, Gengyun Li, Yan Zhao, Jianxiang Liu, Leifeng Zhao, Yun Zheng, Farhat Abbas, Yiwei Zhou, Yanguo Ke
pmc-12610381.description: Apple (Malus domestica) is a woody fruit tree belonging to the Rosaceae family, genus Malus. It has been widely reported that MYB transcription factors are critical regulators for the red color of apple peel by activating the expression of anthocyanin biogenesis genes. However, it is still not clear what the molecular mechanism for the yellow color of apple peel is.

pmc-12676468.title: Gene expression evolution is predicted by stronger indirect selection at more pleiotropic genes
pmc-12676468.creator: Eva L Koch, Charles Rocabert, Champak Beeravolu Reddy, Frédéric Guillaume
pmc-12676468.description: Changes in gene expression levels are central to adaptation, yet predicting and understanding their evolution remains challenging. Here, we used transcriptome-wide variation in the red flour beetle Tribolium castaneum to identify genes under selection for expression changes during adaptation to heat and drought stress and to uncover the mechanisms driving these changes.

pmc-12751288.title: Epidemiology and Risk Factors Characteristics of Alzheimer’s Disease in Southwestern China: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12751288.creator: Yuhang Zhu, Hongli Liu, Miao He, Zucai Xu, Lv Sun, Zhenyu Wu, Xi Niu, Shihui Huang, Jiafu Wang, Xueqin Ran
pmc-12751288.description: BackgroundTo address the regional heterogeneity of Alzheimer’s disease, a large-scale epidemiological study of 12,421 elderly individuals was conducted in southwestern China to depict its unique risk characteristics.MethodsA total of 12,421 subjects were selected via cluster sampling from southwestern China after low quality data were filtered out.

pmc-13227672.title: Prediction of disease resilience of pigs using multi-omics data
pmc-13227672.creator: Yulu Chen, Steven Lonergan, Kyu-Sang Lim, Jian Cheng, Elda Dervishi, Michael K Dyck, Edward Steadham, PigGen Canada, Frederic Fortin, John C S Harding, Graham S Plastow, Jack C M Dekkers
pmc-13227672.description: BackgroundGenomic prediction is widely used in pig breeding, but phenotypic prediction of complex traits such as disease resilience remains limited because genotypes alone do not capture infection-induced regulatory responses, environmental and management effects, or their interactions. Blood molecular profiles measured in young healthy pigs reflect both genetic and non-genetic influences and may improve prediction of performance under disease challenge.

pmc-13652773.title: Quinolones as anti-Toxoplasma agents: a comprehensive scoping review of in vitro and in vivo efficacy
pmc-13652773.creator: Maryam Hataminejad, Marzieh Asadi, Saeed Emami, Moozhan Mofidi, Mahbobeh Montazeri
pmc-13652773.description: Toxoplasmosis is a globally prevalent parasitic disease with significant therapeutic limitations, especially in vulnerable populations. This scoping review assesses the efficacy of quinolones against Toxoplasma gondii in vitro and in vivo. PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, Embase, Scopus, ProQuest, and Google Scholar were searched from inception to August 2024. Original English-language studies evaluating quinolone effects on T. gondii were included.
